f1_comparison_note: The baseline is scored row-level: it alerts when a metric is already past its static threshold, which coincides with rows labelled as faults, inflating its F1. The BiLSTM is scored on 10-sample sliding windows and fires before thresholds are crossed, so its anticipations are penalised as errors against row labels. The fair comparison is lead time, anticipation window, false-alert rate, and usability, not raw F1.
